description: SlackMessageSendComponent — post business-data-driven alerts to Slack.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key registered by a SlackResourceComponent. Takes priority over token_env_var when both are set.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var with a Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Used when resource_key is not set.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'per_row': one Slack message per upstream row, using row fields in templates. 'summary': one message per run, with all rows rendered in the body via summary_template.

channel_template.label: Channel Template
channel_template.description: Target channel/user template — `{column}` placeholders against upstream row. Example: '#customer-success' (literal) or '{slack_channel}' (per-row routing). Accepts a channel ID, a '#name', or a user ID for a DM.

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Message text, with `{column}` placeholders. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting.

summary_template.label: Summary Template
summary_template.description: For mode='summary', a template rendered against the whole DataFrame's row summary (use `{row_count}` / `{table_md}`, a markdown table of up to 50 rows).

thread_ts_column.label: Thread Ts Column
thread_ts_column.description: Optional upstream column holding a thread_ts to reply in an existing thread, per row.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If True, render and log every message but don't post to Slack. Use for staging.

max_send.label: Max Send
max_send.description: Hard cap on messages sent per run. None = no limit.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Useful for transient errors like network glitches or rate limits.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

name: Slack Message Send
